comments.value: TF2 totally nailed global announcements, like this one here. Information is the key in VRChat, and they definitely need to make something similar.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details: It would be nice to have a in-game announcement system in place so when there are server issues like what happened a few days ago we can be told not to change world's till the issue is resolved. More often than not finding out from discord comes to late.
title: In-game announcement system
